title: Why? #1: odd numbers add up to a square → NDA 2026 (I) Q20 (43 s, continuous motion)

captions.instagram:
Why? #1 · Why do odd numbers add up to a square? 🟦

1 = 1², 1 + 3 = 2², 1 + 3 + 5 = 3²… Each new L around the square adds the next odd number, so 1 + 3 + 5 + … + (2n − 1) = n².

NDA 2026 (I) asked exactly this (Maths Q20): |Mₖ| = k² − (k − 1)² = 2k − 1, so |M₁| = 1, |M₂| = 3, |M₃| = 5 … |M₅₀| = 99 and |M₁| + … + |M₅₀| = 1 + 3 + … + 99 = 50² = 2500 → (c).
